title: Asset
description: Data in the Elasticsearch index for an asset

id.description: Internal ID exposed by the API. This is NOT the _id automatically created by ES

driverId.description: Storage driver id used for storing the asset data

storageType.description: Storage driver to use for storing the asset data. Currently-supported values: 'file' or 'gcp'

userId.description: Identifies the user an asset belongs to. This is an arbitrary string

tenantId.description: Identifies the tenant an asset belongs to. This is an arbitrary string

virtualFolder.description: Part of the virtualPath associated to the folder (used for listings)

virtualPath.description: Public, user-provided full path for the asset

storagePath.description: Storage driver-specific pathname (GPC path, local file path, etc)

extractedContentStoragePath.description: Storage driver-specific pathname for extracted content (GPC path, local file path, etc)

creationTimestamp.description: Asset creation time as an ISO 8601 timestamp
